title: Concept: Internal identifier in a data attribute
description: A data attribute that exposes an internal record identifier in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The identifier names the back-office key for the record, which is the value an attacker needs to aim a direct object reference at the internal service.
applicability: Deployments that render a data attribute that exposes an internal record identifier into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The identifier names the back-office key for the record, which is the value an attacker needs to aim a direct object reference at the internal service.
